lines.text: A word is just a label. You can't do math with a label.
But for the machine, every word is a direction. King points one way. Man points another.
So do the math. Start with the direction of king.
Subtract the direction of man. Add the direction of woman.
The arrow lands — almost exactly — on queen.
Nobody programmed that answer. The directions learned it from the company the words keep.
Meaning you can add and subtract. Directions do arithmetic.
